channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Flávio publica carta no Dia dos Pais após Moraes negar visita a Bolsonaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro published a letter to his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, on Father's Day, after Justice Alexandre de Moraes denied a visit to the former president. The message, shared on social media, reinforces familial and political support amid judicial restrictions.

item.title: Após Moraes negar visita, Flávio Bolsonaro escreve carta para Jair e chora
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro posted a video reading an emotional letter to his father, Jair Bolsonaro, after being barred from visiting him by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes. The act took place on Father's Day and was shared on social media, where the senator cried while expressing longing and outrage over the prohibition of family contact.

item.title: Milei precisa ‘parar as agressões’ a Lula, diz Mauro Vieira
item.description: Brazil’s Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira said Argentine President Javier Milei must stop attacking Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva for bilateral relations to return to normal. Speaking to Argentine newspaper Clarín in an interview published March 9, Vieira emphasized that a gesture from Milei is needed to restore dialogue. The comment reflects Brazil’s concern over the escalating hostile rhetoric between the two leaders.

item.title: Depois do ‘nunca antes’, Lula recorre ao ‘quem nunca’ — e o efeito é cômico
item.description: President Lula used the phrase 'who has never asked a friend for a loan?' to defend his former chief of staff, Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro (Marcola), after reports that Marcola received money from a businesswoman with private interests before the government. The argument attempts to normalize the behavior through a rhetorical appeal to common experience, but is seen as comic and inappropriate, as it overlooks the clear potential conflict of interest. Lula’s defense contrasts with his usual rhetoric of exceptionalism ('never before'), revealing an effort to downplay an ethically questionable episode.

item.title: Flávio participa de culto de Dia dos Pais ao lado de Eduardo Cunha
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro attended an evangelical service in São Paulo on Father's Day alongside Eduardo Cunha, expressing sorrow over being barred from visiting his father, Jair Bolsonaro, due to a ruling by Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes. He urged the faithful to cherish family bonds, calling the visitation ban inhumane and unjust.

item.title: Flávio faz cobrança pública a Campagnolo por apoio a Carluxo
item.description: State deputy Ana Campagnolo (PL-SC) posted a video alongside Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, but received a public demand from him to record a statement supporting his brother, Carlos Bolsonaro’s, Senate campaign in Santa Catarina. The request came after the video was shared on social media, highlighting internal family pressure within the Bolsonaro clan to align political endorsements.

item.title: Corrida pela Democracia leva esporte, inclusão e cidadania ao Autódromo Internacional de Brasília
item.description: The first Democracy Race gathered around 900 participants at the Nelson Piquet International Autodrome in Brasília, closing the National Week of the Electronic Voting System. Organized by the Superior Electoral Court (TSE), the event promoted citizenship, inclusion, and democratic participation, featuring experienced athletes, first-time runners, people with disabilities, and families celebrating Father’s Day.

item.title: O pôquer verbal de Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro quando o assunto é o ajuste fiscal
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan faced pressure from financial market agents in São Paulo meetings to reveal post-2026 election fiscal adjustment plans, as the general government gross debt reached 81.9% of GDP in June 2024 — near critical levels seen during Bolsonaro's pandemic-era management. While Durigan states the government continues improving fiscal trajectory with R$17.9 billion blocked in the budget, Lula's campaign avoids announcing spending cuts before the election, waiting to assess post-election political strength and congressional composition. Senator Flávio Bolsonaro is cited as Lula's main rival in polls, though his fiscal stance is not detailed in the excerpt.

item.title: Ao lado de Cunha, Flávio chora durante culto de Valdemiro para Dia dos Pais
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), a 2026 presidential candidate, attended a service at the Mundial do Poder de Deus church led by Pastor Valdemiro Santiago in São Paulo, where he was seen crying emotionally. Former deputy Eduardo Cunha, a candidate for the Federal Chamber from Minas Gerais, was also present at the event held this morning in honor of Father's Day.

item.title: Genial/Quaest: Lula lidera entre mulheres em todos os cenários de segundo turno
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva leads among female voters in all second-round scenarios for the 2026 elections, according to the Genial/Quaest poll. Lula's advantage among women remains consistent regardless of his opponent in the runoff.

item.title: ACM Neto declara R$ 85 milhões em patrimônio ao TSE, mais que o dobro de 2022
item.description: ACM Neto, candidate for governor of Bahia from the União party, declared R$85 million in assets to the TSE in 2026, more than double the R$42 million reported in 2022. The increase was driven by financial investments, which rose from approximately R$20 million to R$52 million, with significant allocations in funds (R$32.3 million), fixed income (R$19.7 million), and corporate participations (R$14.6 million).

item.title: Em congresso, Renan Santos chama Moro de "um rato, fraco, derrotado"
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate for the Missão party, called Sergio Moro a 'rat, weak, defeated' during a congress in Curitiba, criticating his current stance after previously praising his role in Operation Lava Jato. He also attacked Deltan Dallagnol, calling him a 'rodent' and 'vagabond'. The remarks were made amid boos and insults directed at Moro by the audience.

item.title: Proibido de visitar o pai, Flávio Bolsonaro escreve carta: "Até breve"
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL presidential candidate, wrote an emotional letter to his father, Jair Bolsonaro, on Father's Day, expressing longing and hope after being barred from visiting him by a Supreme Court order from Justice Alexandre de Moraes. The restriction, part of a 30-day measure suspending non-essential visits to the former president, was upheld due to Flavio’s violation of court orders, including sharing his father’s letters on social media. In the letter, Flávio also noted the campaign’s progress, stating they had secured strong electoral slates in nearly all states with support from centrist party leaders, despite lacking formal endorsements.

item.title: Flávio escreve carta a Bolsonaro no Dia dos Pais: “Não poderei te dar um abraço”
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) shared an emotional video on Father's Day, appearing in tears while writing a letter to his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro. He revealed that his request to visit his father was denied, so he cannot give him a physical embrace and can only follow the situation from afar. The video, posted on Sunday, June 9, sparked widespread reaction on social media.

item.title: O avanço das investigações contra Lulinha no STF e as novas revelações a caminho
item.description: Investigators recently received a dossier indicating that businessman Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, is being financially supported in Spain by a construction company with billion-dollar contracts in the Lula government, according to Federal Police sources. The material submitted to the STF is described as devastating for Lulinha and may also implicate President Lula, who might need to replace a key government aide amid ongoing investigations into his allies.

item.title: Flávio participa de culto no Dia dos Pais com Eduardo Cunha e se emociona ao falar de Bolsonaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) participated in an evangelical service on Father's Day in São Paulo, where he became emotional when mentioning he could not visit his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, under house arrest. He prayed for wisdom and strength for his father, criticized Minister Alexandre de Moraes' decision denying family visits, and defended the right of parents and children to embrace, calling the ban inhumane. The event was attended by Eduardo Cunha and Dani Cunha and livestreamed on Flávio's social media.

item.title: Atacar urnas e vacinas é tão golpista quanto roubar grana via zap
item.description: TSE President Nunes Marques defended the legitimacy of Brazil's electoral system, stating that discrediting voting machines and vaccines is as undemocratic as corruption through messaging apps. He emphasized that questioning the electoral process discourages citizen participation in what he called Brazil's greatest democratic celebration. The statement comes amid rising attacks on election integrity and public health in Brazil.

item.title: Quaest: Lula ganha de Flávio Bolsonaro no Nordeste e entre mulheres
item.description: In a potential runoff between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, Lula leads nationally with 44% to 39%, though the margin is within the poll's error range. His strongest support comes from the Northeast (64% vs 25%), women (47% vs 35%), younger and older voters, and low-income households (up to two minimum wages: 54% vs 30%). Flávio leads in the South (56% vs 29%), among men (44% vs 40%), and in higher income brackets.

item.title: Ataques de Milei contra Lula devem parar "imediatamente", diz Vieira
item.description: Brazilian Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira said that Argentine President Javier Milei's attacks against Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva must stop immediately, stressing that the bilateral relationship depends on ending the hostility. Vieira stated that Brazil’s ambassador to Argentina, Julio Bitelli, could return to his post once the attacks cease, noting that a simple gesture — such as ending the insults — would be enough to restore diplomatic normalcy. The dispute began after Milei called Lula a 'thief' and 'convict' at a Brazilian liberal party event in July.

item.title: O que Lula quer negociar com Davi Alcolumbre
item.description: President Lula plans to advocate for a judicial reform starting in 2027 if re-elected in 2026, responding to criticism over his STF appointments, particularly the rejection of Jorge Messias. He is negotiating with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre to re-nominate Messias for the vacancy left by Barroso, while also exploring options like raising the minimum age for Supreme Court justices to weaken Messias’s prospects and avoid fixed-term mandates for judges.

item.title: Nunes Marques diz que desacreditar urnas eletrônicas é ‘desconvidar eleitor brasileiro’
item.description: Supreme Electoral Court Minister Kassio Nunes Marques defended the credibility of Brazil's electronic voting machines at the Democracy Race event, stating that questioning the system is 'disinviting the Brazilian voter' from participating in democracy. He emphasized three decades of technological advancement and oversight mechanisms that have ensured transparency and reliability. The remarks followed claims by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, who falsely alleged Venezuelan company Smartmatic's involvement in fraud, though he later denied attacking the integrity of the voting system.

item.title: Derrite mais que dobra o patrimônio em quatro anos
item.description: Federal deputy Guilherme Derrite (PP-SP) more than doubled his wealth between 2022 and 2026, increasing from R$ 812,000 to R$ 2 million — a 148.66% rise. Half of this growth stems from purchasing 50% of a property valued at R$ 1.1 million, whose location remains undisclosed. He is running for Senate in São Paulo on Tarcísio de Freitas’s ticket and claims the asset growth results from legitimate income and family investments.

item.title: Lula vende um governo ao eleitor; Durigan, outro à Faria Lima
item.description: Lula presents voters with an 84-page electoral platform emphasizing rights expansion, public investment and social policies, while omitting fiscal terms like public debt, fiscal target and surplus. Meanwhile, Planning Minister Dario Durigan tells financial institutions austerity is Lula’s authorized vision, advocating spending caps, new fiscal triggers and a 0.5% of GDP primary surplus by 2027 — none of which appears in the TSE-registered program. The disconnect reveals a dual strategy: expansive promises for voters, strict fiscal discipline for markets.

item.title: Nunes Marques defende urna eletrônica e diz que duvidar do sistema eleitoral é ‘desconvidar’ eleitor
item.description: TSE President Justice Kassio Nunes Marques defended electronic voting machines as a cornerstone of Brazilian democracy, stating that doubting the electoral system is 'disinviting the Brazilian voter from participating in the country's greatest democratic festival'. His remarks came during the Democracy Run, amid false claims by Flávio Bolsonaro and a failed attempt by U.S. officials to challenge the system's integrity.

item.title: O Dia dos Pais de Lula e Bolsonaro
item.description: Three sons of Jair Bolsonaro were unable to see him on Father's Day, June 9, due to a political act by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, who read a letter from the father to reinforce his 2026 presidential candidacy. The gesture occurred during a family event, highlighting the Bolsonaro clan's mobilization around the former president's potential return to office.

item.title: Patrimônio de Ciro Gomes cai quase pela metade em quatro anos
item.description: Ciro Gomes (PSDB) declared to the Electoral Justice a net worth of R$ 1.7 million in 2026, about half of the R$ 3 million he reported in 2022 when running for president. His most valuable asset is an apartment valued at R$ 889 thousand, along with two cars, three properties and stakes in two companies. Despite the wealth decline, he leads the race for Ceará governor with 43% voting intentions, according to Quaest, backed by Bolsonaro’s PL party.

item.title: Quem é o Trump brasileiro, candidato a deputado federal por MG
item.description: Plínio Vicentin Junior, a 60-year-old airplane pilot, decided to enter politics due to his resemblance to Donald Trump and is running for federal deputy from Minas Gerais under the Novo party, using the name 'Plínio Trump' on the ballot. He supports Trump’s tariffs against Brazil, the former U.S. president’s anti-immigration policies, plans to vote for Romeu Zema for president, and expressed distrust in electronic voting machines—though he still believes they will allow his election. His declared assets total R$1.6 million, including two properties, a car, and land.

item.title: Desacreditar sistema de votação “desconvida” eleitor, diz Nunes Marques
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques defended the security of electronic voting machines at the 'Race for Democracy' event, stating that undermining confidence in the voting system can discourage voters from participating in elections. He emphasized that trust in the electoral system is crucial for voter engagement.

item.title: Pesquisas eleitorais mostram a distância entre Lula e Flávio após números da semana
item.description: Three national polls released last week show Lula ahead of Flávio Bolsonaro in the presidential race, though with varying margins. BTG/Nexus indicates the closest contest, with Lula at 41% and Flávio at 37% in the first round (4-point gap), and a technical tie in the runoff (46% to 45%). Other polls (Genial/Quaest and Meio/Ideia) show larger leads for Lula, but all agree he remains the frontrunner with Flávio as his main challenger.

item.title: Nunes Marques: plataformas concordaram com plano contra desinformação
item.description: TSE President Minister Kassio Nunes Marques stated that digital platforms have agreed with the Electoral Court's compliance plan to counter disinformation in the 2026 elections, including actions against deepfakes and harmful AI use. He noted that efforts are progressing significantly and that platform tools will be made available to Brazilian voters. The comments follow the PL convention's display of an AI-generated video of Bolsonaro, sparking debate over whether it constitutes a deepfake given its disclaimer.

item.title: Kassio defende urna e diz que desacreditar sistema de votação é desconvidar eleitor
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques defended Brazil's electronic voting machines, stating that discrediting the voting system is equivalent to discouraging voters from participating. He emphasized the importance of trust in the electoral process to ensure citizen engagement.

item.title: 'Desacreditar o sistema de votação é desconvidar o eleitor a comparecer às urnas', diz presidente do TSE
item.description: TSE President Minister Nunes Marques warned that undermining the voting system discourages voter turnout. He emphasized the court's efforts to ensure transparency and security of electronic voting machines, including the creation of the Advisory Council on Informational Integrity for the 2026 Elections and agreements with platforms to counter disinformation.

item.title: O pedido da defesa de Lulinha ao ministro da Justiça sobre a PF
item.description: The defense of Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) urged Justice Minister Wellington Silva to investigate alleged PF data leaks in investigations against him. Lawyer Marco Aurélio de Carvalho claims a 'lava jato-aligned' faction within the PF is acting to harm Lulinha and benefit Flávio Bolsonaro. Following the pressure, Silva spoke with André Mendonça, leading to the case being split between Mendonça and Flávio Dino in a rare dual rapporteur arrangement.

item.title: PT mira "bancada dos trabalhadores" com apoio de Benedita e Talíria
item.description: The PT is working to form the 'Workers' Banc' in the Chamber of Deputies, an initiative proposed by federal deputy candidate Moisés Selerges (PT-SP) and already endorsed by Lula. The proposal aims to specifically defend the rights of Brazil's working class and has gained the support of federal deputies Benedita da Silva (PT-RJ) and Talíria Petrone (PSol-RJ), strengthening left-wing coordination.

item.title: O refúgio do canalha (por Gaudêncio Torquato)
item.description: The text discusses the concept of false patriotism, based on Samuel Johnson's quote, and its application in current Brazilian politics, especially the 2026 presidential campaign. Candidates, such as Lula, use national symbols and historical narratives to legitimize their candidacies, often masking personal ambitions or government failures with patriotic rhetoric. True patriotism, according to the author, lies in respect for institutions, defense of democracy, and service to the collective — not in empty rhetoric or political use of the flag.

item.title: Presidente do TSE defende urnas eletrônicas durante evento em Brasília
item.description: TSE President Minister Kassio Nunes Marques defended Brazil's electronic voting system during the Democracy Run in Brasília, stating its credibility was strengthened through technological improvements and oversight mechanisms. He warned that discrediting the system discourages voter participation in Brazil's democratic process. The event took place at the Nelson Piquet International Autodrome as part of the National Week of the Electronic Voting System.

item.title: Nunes Marques defende urnas eletrônicas e fala que desacreditar sistema de votação é 'desconvidar eleitor'
item.description: Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, president of the TSE, defended the credibility of electronic voting machines during the Democracy Run in Brasília, stating that discrediting the voting system is 'disinviting' voters from participating in elections. He emphasized the robustness, auditability, and technological evolution of Brazil's voting system amid attacks and disinformation, including false claims by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro about the urns.

item.title: Campanha quer 'desavermelhar' o PT, mas dona Lu ensina o partido a voltar ao vermelho
item.description: Lula's campaign for a fourth term is being 'de-reddened' to appeal to markets and independent voters, emphasizing green, yellow, and white in PT events to counter Bolsonaro's appropriation of Brazil's national colors. The strategy highlights the PT's alliance with center-right forces, while the symbolic figure of 'dona Lu' represents a return to the party's red roots. The effort seeks to balance modernization with historical identity amid deep political polarization.

item.title: Elas decidem a eleição (por Mary Zaidan)
item.description: Women, comprising 52.8% of the electorate, are decisive in the 2026 elections. Their majority benefits President Lula, whose approval among them is high, while harming Flávio Bolsonaro, rejected by 54% of female voters due to macho statements and his regressive view of women's roles. Michelle Bolsonaro's absence from Flávio's campaign events, despite reconciliation efforts, underscores the weakness of his appeal to female voters.

item.title: A jornada dupla de metade dos presidentes nacionais de partidos nas eleições
item.description: Half of the national presidents of the 30 parties registered with the TSE are running in the 2026 elections, indicating a high level of partisan engagement in the electoral process. The subscriber-only article highlights that these party leaders are competing for elected offices, which could influence party strategies and internal dynamics.

item.title: Lula registra candidatura com 88 certidões criminais
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) filed his re-election candidacy at the TSE, submitting 88 criminal records. Renan Santos (Mission) and Romeu Zema (Novo) also filed candidacies, with five and 12 criminal records, respectively.

item.title: Flávio admite vice de última hora e deixa porta de saída aberta
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro admitted that the selection of Alfredo Gaspar as his running mate on the PL ticket was decided at the last minute, contradicting PL president Valdemar Costa Neto, who claimed the decision had been kept secret for six months. The revelation came during a live appearance on Noblat's program, where Flávio said the idea emerged the day before the convention following an emergency call from Senator Rogério Marinho. The PL leadership in Alagoas left a gap in the convention minutes as a tactical loophole, allowing Gaspar to withdraw from the vice-presidential slot and re-enter the Senate race before the final registration deadline if voter and market rejection becomes untenable.

item.title: Tarcísio e Haddad vão a debate com cara de 2° turno
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) and former Finance Minister Fernando Haddad (PT) face off this Sunday (9) in the first debate between candidates for São Paulo governor, marked by a second-round tone. The encounter takes place amid heated disputes over security, economy, and public management, with both aiming to solidify their electoral bases.

item.title: Milei compartilha fala de deputado dos EUA que chama Lula de “corrupto e criminoso”
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei shared on social media a statement by U.S. Republican Congressman Carlos Gimenez, who labeled Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva as 'corrupt and criminal'. Gimenez also claimed Lula damaged the historic alliance between Brazil and the United States. Milei’s sharing reflects his ideological alignment with conservative U.S. factions and his ongoing criticism of the Lula government.

item.title: Governador do Mato Grosso doa R$ 3 milhões ao Republicanos
item.description: The governor of Mato Grosso, Otaviano Pivetta (Republicanos), donated R$ 3 million to his party in July, becoming its largest donor, surpassing businessman Rubens Ometto, who had contributed R$ 700 thousand. The donation was recorded as a personal contribution for party maintenance, despite Pivetta being affiliated with the Republicans. He is an agribusiness producer, born in Rio Grande do Sul, living in Mato Grosso since 1982, and was elected vice-governor in 2018 on Mauro Mendes' (União Brasil) ticket, re-elected in 2022 after joining the Republicans.

item.title: Frase do dia
item.description: Lula criticizes high interest‑rate policy, saying those who set the rates do not understand how poor people live, treating them merely as numbers, whereas for him the poor are women and men with lives.

item.title: A reconciliação para inglês ver de Michelle e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro allegedly reconciled with Flávio Bolsonaro after 17 days of estrangement, accepting his apology and announcing plans to 'gather a great army of people'. The report was published as exclusive content for subscribers, requiring registration for full access.

item.title: Haddad e Tarcísio voltam a se enfrentar em debate 4 anos depois
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) and former mayor Fernando Haddad (PT) are set to face off in a debate today, four years after competing for the state governorship in 2022. The encounter takes place amid intense political polarization and may shape voter perceptions ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Pesquisa Quaest: para 86% dos brasileiros, é 'importante' que candidato à Presidência acredite em Deus
item.description: Genial/Quaest poll shows 86% of Brazilians consider it important for a presidential candidate to believe in God, rising to 91% in the Northeast. While belief in God is widely valued, only 26% find it important that the candidate shares their own religion. No candidate has yet declared themselves an atheist, which could pose additional electoral challenges.

item.title: O que ex-assessor de Lula ainda não disse sobre o 'empréstimo' que tomou de lobista ligada ao Careca do INSS
item.description: Former Lula aide Marco Aurélio Ribeiro, known as Marcola, released two public statements explaining a 'loan' of R$249,000 received from lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, linked to the so-called 'INSS Careca'. He claims to have made a bank transfer of that amount but did not disclose the source or purpose of the funds. The case raises suspicions of influence peddling or conflict of interest, though no illegal activity has been proven.
